title: Method A Hole Benchmark Candidate E10 Multi-Layer Production Deck Generation, Static Qualification, and Local Datacheck
scientific_objective: Transition from the Section 4.3 reference study back to the primary thesis benchmark (1.0 x 1.0 mm plate with 0.5 mm initial notch and circular hole at (0.65, 0.65) mm). Assemble the approved narrow crack-following physical mesh Candidate E10 (PK_HOLE_SEL_E10_PHYS.inp, 9,164 physical elements, 27,753 DOFs) into an authoritative 3-layer UEL production input deck (PK_HOLE_SEL_E10_PROD.inp), perform exhaustive card-by-card static verification against frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (ce8d5edc...), execute an offline Abaqus/Standard local datacheck to verify Exit Code 0 with zero negative element Jacobians, and submit for independent review without consuming cluster PBS jobs.
